cases.purpose: Private path collisions, real /dev/full write failure, same-inode cleanup, signal restoration and descriptors are observed.
cases.oracle: A private AF_UNIX sender, independently bound loopback UDP receiver, actual /dev/full failure, inode and descriptor observations, owned-process signals and scoped syscall notification records.
cases.comparison: Before each candidate scenario, a guest-only control proves one destination-specific sendto EIO while unrelated UDP and UNIX datagrams succeed and a real /dev/full write fails with ENOSPC; exact before/after queue bytes, datagram bytes, owned process identity, syscall arguments and per-run bootstrap traces are saved. HUP timing must fit in the same measured monotonic startup second; a missed timing control is an infrastructure error.
cases.stdout: syslog-safety collision=yes stale=yes write=yes inode=yes signals=yes fds=yes
